site.sitedescription: Pintler Lake is dammed behind a late-Pleistocene end moraine. The montane forest surrounding the lake is dominated by Pinus contorta with Pseudotsuga menziesii and Picea engelmannii as minor components. Dominant understory species include Arctostaphylos uva-ursi, Artemisia tridentata, Linnea borealis, and Ribes.
